scheme_name: Private Tuition Assistance to Scheduled Caste Students Studying in Standard 11th & 12th (Science Stream)
other_conditions: Student must be studying in Standard 11th or 12th Science Stream.
Student must have obtained 70% or more marks in Standard 10th.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹15,000 per annum for private tuition fees in 11th standard and another ₹15,000 per annum in 12th standard.
